previousRuns.stopReason: Stopped on the owner's instruction after eight requests. Live v2 misclassified a held-only route as unconditional; the acknowledgement workflow dropped its explicit human-review line. Both semantic defects were preserved for repair before a new deployment. The last two inputs were not sent to this target.

consequenceProbeBoundary: For inspection, each valid response is applied directly to the local pure A/B/C engine. These offline consequence probes are not student episodes, do not call a model for C, and do not change the UI rule that C follows two runs and uses the frozen second mapping.
